frequency_question: How often do statutory review periods for major nuclear/arms cooperation agreements result in a successfully enacted joint resolution of disapproval overcoming or avoiding presidential vetoes?
membership_rule: Includes all formal notifications of 123 agreements or major foreign military sales subject to congressional disapproval via joint resolution under the Atomic Energy Act or Arms Export Control Act. Excludes simple resolutions, concurrent resolutions, and bills outside the specific statutory fast-track windows.

cases.name: Saudi Arabia/UAE arms sales emergency bypass

coverage_note: 4 major historical flashpoints examined where congressional opposition peaked; none successfully completed the statutory criteria of passing a joint resolution and preventing entry into force via veto override.
known_gaps: Minor informal notifications without floor votes are omitted as they never reached the criteria stage.
skeleton: Total formal major nuclear/arms cooperation review periods since 1976 yielding successful bicameral joint resolutions of disapproval enacted into law over or without presidential veto.
